mapper.sql: select m.merchant_id, m.name, m.category, m.description, m.logo_url, m.images, m.address, m.lat, m.lng, m.phone, m.business_hours, m.contact_info, m.service_radius_km, m.promoter_id, m.owner_member_id, m.status, m.reject_reason, m.review_time, m.reviewer, m.sort, m.del_flag, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark, pm.nick_name as promoter_name from mall_merchant m left join mall_member pm on pm.member_id = m.promoter_id
mapper.select: where m.del_flag = '0' and m.status = '1' order by m.sort asc, m.merchant_id asc
where m.del_flag = '0' and m.promoter_id = #{promoterId} order by m.create_time desc
select count(1) from mall_merchant where del_flag = '0' and promoter_id = #{promoterId}
mapper.insert: insert into mall_merchant(name, category, description, logo_url, images, address, lat, lng, phone, business_hours, contact_info, service_radius_km, promoter_id, owner_member_id, status, sort, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values(#{name}, #{category}, #{description}, #{logoUrl}, #{images}, #{address}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{phone}, #{businessHours}, #{contactInfo}, ifnull(#{serviceRadiusKm}, 5), #{promoterId}, #{ownerMemberId}, ifnull(#{status}, '0'), ifnull(#{sort}, 0), '0', #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update mall_merchant set del_flag = '2' where merchant_id = #{merchantId}
